name: Sasakawa Iku
source:
"Scouted by the Director from another company; she often helps out at his, and he was told by his seniors to replay that debt. He has been acting since he was six years old, but his first guest role with a different theatre troupe is with MANKAI Company. He is humble and hardworking, and noted by the Director to closely observe others' acting. She also notes that he is aware of his own cuteness."

[From the [url=https://yaycupcake.com/a3/index.php?title=Ensemble_Cast]A3! Wiki[/url]]
